content: Jovashinchagairi Jesús omatziri pathaarontsi
Ikanta joirinkaa Jesús ikinkithatakera tonkaari otzishiki, joyaatairi osheki atziri.
Ari ipokashitakeriri aparoni atziri omatziri pathaarontsi, jotyeerovashitapaakari Jesús, ikantapaakeri: “Pikovirika, ari onkantake povashinchagaina.”
Iroora jakotashitantanakariri, jantantakari kapicheeni irako, ikantzi: “Nokovi, peshitakotai.” Eshitanake ipathaavaiveta.

Ipoña Jesús ikantavetavaari: “Eerora pikamantakotana. Apatziro povanakero piyaatashiteri omperatasorentsitaari, pimonkaratantyaarori Ikantakaantane Moisés, pimperi pashitakaariri Pava, iriyotantaityaari eshitakotaimi.”
Jovashinchagairi Jesús irotzikatane ijevare ovayiriite
Ikanta jovaanaa Jesús, areetaiyakani nampitsiki Capernaum. Ari ipokakeri ijevare ovayiriite Roma-satzi, iriñeeri Jesús,
ikantapaakeri: “Novinkatharite, tzimatsi notzikatane nopankoki, maperokitaka imantsiyatake, kisoporokitake.”
Jakanakeri, ikantziri: “Aritake niyaatake novashinchagairi.”

Iro kantamaitacha ikantanake irirori: “Osheki noñaapinkathatakemi eeroka, kaaripero nonake naaka, niyotzi eero okantzi pinkyaavankotena. Intaani nokovi pinkantakaanteri, ireshitakotai. Tema aritake omatakya pinkanteri.

Tema tzimatsi omperatanari naaka, tzimatsi eejatzi ovayiripayeeni nomperatari naaka. Aririka nonkanteri: ‘Piyaate,’ aritake iriyaatake. Aririka nonkante pashine: ‘Pimpoke,’ aritake impokake. Aririka nonkanteri notzikatane: ‘Pantero iroka,’ jimatziro jantziro.”

Ipampoyaanakeri Jesús ikemakeri ikantake irika ijevare ovayiriite. Ikantanakeri oyaataiyirini: “Iriira matakerori irika ikempisantzi, jaka Israel-ki te intzime aparoni asheninka kempityaarine. Omaperora.

Pinkeme, aririka impinkathariventantai Inkitesatzi, ari intzimake osheki kaari asheninkata poñaayetachari pashineki nampitsi, tsika intzime anintaayetaachane intsipataiyaari Abraham-ni, Isaac-ni eejatzi Jacob-ni.

Iro kantamaitacha eerora itzimaperotai asheninka saikaatsineri janta. Iriitake ikovakaaveetakari impinkathariventairimi maaroni janta, oshekimaitaka ipiyathataka, irootake irookantaiyaariri otsirenikitake. Ari iriraavaitaiyaari, iratsikaikivaitya inkemaantsitaiya.”

Ipithokashitanaari ijevare ovayiriite, ikantziri: “Pimatairo pimpiye pipankoki. Tema pimatakero pikempisantzi eeroka, irootake ireshitakotantaiyaari potzikatane.” Aripaitera javisakotanake irotzikatane janta ipankoki.
Jovashinchagairo Jesús iriyote Pedro
Ikanta Jesús jatake ipankoki Pedro. Iñaapaatziiro iriyote, onoryaaka, aakero saavakirentsi.
Ipampitapaakero kapicheeni akoki, eshitakotanake. Piriintanaka, amenayetavakeneri ompaitya ompavakeriri.
Okanta osheetyaanake, jamaitapaakeneri osheki jaakiri peyari. Jovashinchaayetairi, ikisathatavakerira kapicheeni iveyarite. Jovashinchaayetairi eejatzi maaroni mantsiyayetatsiri.
Arira okanta omonkaraantakari iñaaventakeri pairani kamantantaneri Isaías, ikantakeranki:
Oyaaterine Jesús
Ikanta iñaakeri Jesús joshekiperotapaake atziri apatotzimentariri, ikantanakeri iriyotaane: “Thame amontyagai intatsikero.”
Ikantavetavaari iyotzinkari: “Iyotaantanerí, nokovi noyaatanakemi tsikarika pikenayetzi eeroka.”
Jakanake Jesús, ikantziri: “Aparoni otsitziniro, tzimatsi imoro imaantari, eejatzi tsimeripayeeni tzimatsi iromayero. Iriima irika Itomi Atziri tera otzimi ipanko imaantapiintyaari irirori.”
Ari ikantanake aparoni iriyotaane: “Iyotaanarí, nokovavetaka naaka noyaatanakemi, iro kantamaitacha aririka noñaanairi nirintari nonkitatanairi, arira noyaatemiri.”
Ipoña ikantanakeri Jesús: “Poyaatena. Tema ikaratzi kamashireyetatsiri, ari inkitatairi irirori kaminkaripayeeni.”
Joimairentziro Jesús tampyaa
Ipoña jotetanaa Jesús pitotsiki, itsipatanaari iriyotaane.
Ikanta jimontyaakotanaka, maanake Jesús pitotsiki. Iro joveraakovetaiyakani niyankyaaki, omapokakeri iriyotaane otampyaatapaake antaroite, otetaatapaaka jiñaa pitotsiki, otamakaatanakera inkaare.
Jiyaatashiitanakeri, jovakiryeetapaakeri Jesús, ikantapaakeri: “¡Iyotaanarí, ampiinkatye! ¡Povavisaakotaina!”
Ikantanakeri irirori: “¿Opaitama pitharovantari? ¿Tekerama pikempisantaperotziita?” Piriintanaka, joimairentakero tampyaa eejatzi ikempitakero otamakaane inkaare, avisanake, mairyaatanai kameetha.
Ipampoyaaminthaitanakeri Jesús, iñaapinkathatanakeri iniroite, ikantavakaayeta: “¿Ipaitama atziritatsiri irika? Joimairentziro tampyaa, eejatzi inkaare.”
Gadara-satzi jaakiri peyari

Aritake areetaiyakani intatsikero, aatakotaiyapaakeni nampitsiki paitachari Gadara. Ari ishiyashitavakari apite atziri jaakiri peyari ipoñaakaro kitataariki. Katsimaki ikantakaakari peyari, osheki itharovakaitakari, te arite inkenayeete janta.
Ikantavakeri: “¡Jesús, Itomi Pava! ¿Irootaintsima povasankitaina? ¿Tsikama nokantakemi eeroka?”
Ari itzimi janta osheki chancho, ishintaraavaitaiyini.
Ñaavaitanake iveyarite, ikantanake: “Aririka povavisaakotairi irika naakane, potyaantena naaka ipiyotaka chancho.”

Jakanakeri Jesús, ikantziri: “Piyaate peyari.” Matanaka. Jatanake peyaripayeeni chanchoki, jaakapaakeri, iroora ishiyantaiyanakari imperetatzi otzishi, mitagaiyapaakani maaroni inkaareki, aperotaka ipiinkake.
Ikanta iñaakerira aamaakoventariri, shiyeeyanakani. Jatake nampitsiki, ikamantapaakeri maaroni atziri okaratzi iñaakeri.
Iroora jiyaatashiitantanakariri Jesús, ikantaitapaakeri: “Te nonkovaiyeni pisaiki nonampiki, pamene tsika pinkene.”

footnotes.text: 8.8 Irika ijevare ovayiriite Roma-satzi, kaarira Judío, pashinesatzi atziri jinatzi. Tema pairani aparoni Judío, te inkyaavankoteri pashinesatzi kaari isheninkata.
